content: पीयूषः, -षम् [पीय्-उषन्, <ls>Uṇ. 4. 76</ls>] .²1 Nectar, ambrosia; मनसि वचसि काये पुण्यपीयूषपूर्णाः <ls>Bh. 2. 78</ls>; इमां पीयूषलहरीम् <ls>G. L. 53</ls>. .²2 Milk in general. .²3 The milk of a cow during the first seven days after calving. .²4 The first milk given by a cow after calving.
